name: Velocispora ephemera
story: Lives fast. Hyphae are abandoned six hours after they are laid, so the colony is a thin moving ring with nothing behind it, and it fruits in ten hours. Invented by Claude on 2026-11-10 for the plugins: not a real species, and any likeness of the name to a real one is accidental. It takes every value it does not set from the DIF family.
